glossary.definition: (A) "Consumer" means an individual that receives services from a service provider.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5301.75 to 5301.78 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Major home system" includes plumbing, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and electrical wiring.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5301.75 to 5301.78 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Residential real estate" means real property located in this state that is used primarily for personal, family, or household purposes and is improved by one to four dwelling units.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5301.75 to 5301.78 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Service agreement" means a contract under which a person agrees to provide services in connection with the maintenance, purchase, or sale of residential real estate.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5301.75 to 5301.78 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Service provider" means a person that provides services to another person.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5301.75 to 5301.78 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(F) "Unfair service agreement" means an agreement that is void and unenforceable under division (B) of section 5301.76 of the Revised Code.
